tier_0.line_1: Malgrath: …the guild again? Good. I was already dying, Grak.
tier_0.line_2: Malgrath: take the hoard. They came for it — take theirs first.

tier_1.line_1: Malgrath: my breath is short today. Hold the halls.

tier_2.line_1: Malgrath: the heart steadies. The hoard is nearly safe.

tier_3.line_1: Malgrath: I remember when we were the ones they feared.

tier_4.line_1: Malgrath: before you came I was dying. Now I am only resting.

ow_dragon_voice_done.malgrath_they_will_come_again_grak_we: Malgrath: they will come again, Grak. We will be ready.

rift.unheld: the rift still burns where the first expedition broke in
rift.lost: the rift smokes — the guild reached the heart here
rift.held: the rift is held. no blood on the basalt

rotunda.unheld: the heart beats slow in the rotunda
rotunda.lost: the rotunda still aches where they struck
rotunda.held: the heart beats steady in the rotunda

halls.unheld: stone corridors ring hollow with old echoes
halls.lost: the long halls still smell of blood
halls.held: the halls ring empty. the guild lost its way

garden.unheld: the water remembers a temple's prayers
garden.lost: the garden is stained; the water runs red at the edges
garden.held: the garden keeps. the temple stones are quiet

depths.unheld: the depths are uncharted; the dark maps itself
depths.lost: something in the depths is still hunting
depths.held: the depths let you through. barely

heart.unheld: the heart chamber. the final expedition waits
heart.lost: the guild's champion broke through the heart
heart.held: the heart is held. the guild's hunt fails
